blocks: ## D3 - how often players performed (Q3 a-c; FR-001)
## D4 - England, the GM's comparison (Q3 d; FR-001)
## D5 - the implementation check and the reply (FR-003, FR-004)

decisions.summary: Two write sessions in two side-by-side clones: S1 Q1+Q2 (labor questions, sharing 0250/0115/0260/0307), S2 Q3 a-c plus England as its own comparative question; then the reply on #20; no code, map or canon change.
decisions.why: Process organisation of work the request and FR-001 ask for; drops nothing asked. The split is made under FR-002 (at most four questions and ten new keys a write) without citing it; from the bundle each write appears to touch a new question plus up to four existing ones by pointer, so the write sessions must check the per-write count against FR-002's full text. Not a narrowing of the GM's request.

decisions.summary: Search passes are leads, not citations; every passage read on its page before citing; local copies go through make source-pages or the archive, image-only pages through IMAGES=.
decisions.why: Citation discipline under FR-001's citation rules; narrows nothing the GM asked.

decisions.summary: Secondary summaries (Furukawa summaries, chinanews article, Chambers reading Henslowe) cited as what they are, each write-up saying whose evidence it relays; primaries go on the leads list.
decisions.why: Honest labeling of evidence; every requested figure still reported.

decisions.summary: Performance bookends N/A (no generator change); constitution check: question tasks research: physical, record checks green, built as the spec's FRs.
decisions.why: Consistent with a research-only request; no decision against the request.

decisions.summary: Q1 in a new money question built on 0250, 0115 and 0260 with a pointer from each.

Japan first: farm servants' contract rest days (Kumon 2020, 310-330 days), village asobi-bi not summed onto Kumon's, yabuiri attested only for its two days, porters/carpenters/day laborers SILENT on a count with seasonal and weather evidence given as what it is; China's 250 days an assumption, 360 a bookkeeping convention, 200 spinning days an estimate; derived figures labeled as this project's arithmetic; canon comparison (no weekly rest day attested).
decisions.why: Answers Q1's worker list (servant time off, porters' busyness by season) in the requested region order; refusing to add asobi-bi to Kumon's count is evidence discipline, not a carve-out. Not a narrowing, but two requested sub-items carry neither a figure nor a SILENT in the block: 'a farm laborer by season' (Kumon gives a yearly count, not a seasonal split) and the construction worker's 'winter' (weather idling is not winter). SC-002 obliges the reply to give each or its SILENT; the write session must do so.

decisions.summary: Q2 in 0307 or a sibling by 0307's prose cap.

Guards: China's escort-masters kept on by the agency, 3-4 trips a year, house guards between trips, clients contracting by trip/season/year; Japan: courier house's own convoy leader, armed escort hired per trip SILENT, by-the-job pattern attested only for unarmed couriers. Scribes: China by the document; Japan kept on, petition-writing by the case (fee SILENT), day-hired scribe SILENT. Canon check: scribes among the heimen.
decisions.why: Answers Q2's escort and scribe questions, including 'salaried or per trip', 'between jobs' and 'a day or two of writing', with SILENTs where not found; nothing asked is dropped.

decisions.summary: Q3 a-c in a new money question with pointers from 0308, 0214 and 0187.

(a) city playhouses: one daylight program a day, no night playing before 1878, five or six programs a theatrical year from kaomise, 6th-7th months idle, puppet calendar SILENT; (b) shrine-ground licenses of 100 fair-weather days, provincial licenses a year SILENT; (c) country troupes' festival engagements of 1-15 days, engagements a year SILENT; China beside it.
decisions.why: Covers (a)-(c) and the GM's 'literally every night' question, Japan first, China beside it. One requested sub-item of (a), 'how long a program', has neither a figure nor a SILENT in the block; SC-002 obliges the reply to give it or its SILENT.

decisions.summary: The canon's county troupe working market day and touring villages the rest of the week is NOT ATTESTED; routed to the GM through escalation-check.
decisions.why: Reports a finding against the canon to the GM rather than changing canon; FR-003's escalation route. Not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: England in its own question in 'Comparative money', subject=comparative,money, source kind comparative (Chambers reading Henslowe): time of day, six days a week, bill changes, ~243 performances a year as labeled arithmetic, Lent, summer touring, plague inhibitions, Blackfriars; never a Rokugani figure.
decisions.why: FR-001's own placement for Q3 (d); covers every item (d) names (time of day, days a week, bill change, Lent and plague closures).

decisions.summary: implementation-check.md holds each touched question's line (make impl-check); the reply gives each figure with fragment file and verdict, the open leads, the 250-day convention's standing; GM findings through escalation-check first.
decisions.why: Matches FR-003 and FR-004 line for line; reporting the 250-day convention's standing answers the request's stated 'why it matters'.
